title: Job Work Out (दूसरे से बनवाना)
intro:
भाग 8 — Manufacturing & Job Work

कुल Problems: 3 │ 🟢 1 🟡 1 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Raw Material दूसरे को भेजकर Finished Goods वापस लेना और Cost निकालना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

Godown: Our Stock with Third Party

Material Out → Material In

Job Work Charges पर GST

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Job Work Charges को Cost में न जोड़ना

GST को Cost में जोड़ देना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

पहले Job Work Out Order Voucher Enable करें (F10), फिर Material Out/Material In Voucher Type में 'Use for Job Work = Yes' करें। Final Product में Bill of Material (BOM) ज़रूर बनाएँ। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Create the Raw Material & Finished Goods Stock Items with BOM in Tally Prime, pass the Job Work Out Order, Material Out and Material In Vouchers, and verify the effective cost per unit.
guide:
Job Work Out (दूसरे से बनवाना)

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Job Work Out की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Maintain Inventory = Yes, BOM = Yes और Enable Job Order Processing = Yes।
  • Godown बनाएँ: "Our Stock with Third Party" (या Job Worker के नाम का Godown) — Third-Party Stock Godown प्रकार।
  • Raw Material और Finished Goods के Stock Items बनाएँ; Finished Goods में BOM।
  • Job Work Out Order (Voucher Type: Job Work Out Order) में Party, Finished Item, BOM और Job Work Charges भरें।
  • Material Out (Job Work Out) Voucher: Raw Material Godown → Third-Party Godown, Order का Reference चुनकर।
  • Material In (Job Work In/Material In) Voucher: Finished Goods Main Godown में आएँगे; Job Work Charges Additional Cost में।
  • Job Work Charges पर GST अलग Ledger में (Input GST); यह Product Cost में नहीं जुड़ता।
याद रखें

Material Out पर आम तौर पर GST नहीं (Delivery Challan पर्याप्त)।

Finished Cost = Raw Material + Job Work Charges (GST छोड़कर)।

Return की समय-सीमा: Inputs के लिए 1 साल, Capital Goods के लिए 3 साल।
outro:

  • Material Out पर GST?
  • Cost?
  • Return की Time-limit?

✅ उत्तर-कुंजी (पहले खुद हल करें, फिर मिलाएँ)

Problemउत्तर / Check Points
Problem 1Total Cost (Raw Material + Job Work Charges) = ₹ 35,000
Effective Cost per Kg of Finished Rod = ₹ 72.92
Problem 2Raw Material Cost = ₹ 8,600 (Kurti) + ₹ 10,000 (Dupatta) + ₹ 15,000 (Salwar) = ₹ 33,600
Job Work Charges = ₹ 5,000 (100 Pcs × ₹50)
Total Cost = ₹ 38,600
Cost per Pcs of Ladies Suit = ₹ 386
Job Work Charges पर GST 5% = ₹ 250 (CGST 125 + SGST 125) — यह ITC है, Product Cost में नहीं जुड़ता
Problem 3Job Charges = 50 × 60 = ₹ 3,000; GST = ₹ 150
Cost of Shirts = 15,000 + 3,000 = ₹ 18,000 → प्रति Shirt ₹ 360
GST (₹150) ITC है, Cost में नहीं जुड़ती

2. Material + Job Charges

3. सामान्यतः 1 साल (इनपुट)/3 साल (Capital Goods)

problems.title: Steel Rods — Simple Job Work Out
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Sent 500 Kg Raw Steel (cost ₹40/Kg) to Mahesh Fabricators for a cutting Job Work (Job Work Out Order No. MF-1)
  • 2nd April — Material In received: 480 Kg Finished Steel Rods (20 Kg process loss); Job Work Charges paid = ₹ 15,000

problems.title: Ladies Suit Manufacturer — Full Job Work Out Cycle with BOM (Expert)
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

Final Product 'Ladies Suit' का BOM बनाएँ: हर 100 Pcs के लिए Kurti Fabric 172 Mtr + Dupatta Fabric 250 Mtr + Salwar Fabric 250 Mtr लगता है। GST 5% सभी Raw Material व Finished Goods पर।

  • 1st April — Purchased from Aman Trading & Co. (Local): 1,000 Mtr Kurti Fabric @ ₹50/Mtr; 1,000 Mtr Dupatta Fabric @ ₹40/Mtr; 1,000 Mtr Salwar Fabric @ ₹60/Mtr
  • 1st April — Job Work Out Order (100 Pcs Ladies Suit) sent to Shaqib Tailor for Cutting, Stitching & Packaging; Job Work Charges = ₹50/Pcs
  • 2nd April — Material Out: Raw Material (172 Mtr Kurti + 250 Mtr Dupatta + 250 Mtr Salwar) sent to Shaqib Tailor's location (Job Work Out)
  • After 30 days — Material In: 100 Pcs finished Ladies Suit received back from Shaqib Tailor
problems.hint:
• BOM (100 Pcs Ladies Suit): Kurti Fabric 172 Mtr, Dupatta Fabric 250 Mtr, Salwar Fabric 250 Mtr।
  • 1 Apr: Purchase Aman Trading से — Kurti 1,000 Mtr @ 50; Dupatta 1,000 Mtr @ 40; Salwar 1,000 Mtr @ 60 (GST 5%)।
  • 1 Apr: Job Work Out Order Shaqib Tailor को — 100 Pcs Ladies Suit; Job Work Charges ₹50/Pcs।
  • 2 Apr: Material Out — 172 + 250 + 250 Mtr Fabric Third-Party Godown में।
  • 30 दिन बाद: Material In — 100 Pcs Ladies Suit वापस; Job Work Charges ₹5,000 + GST 5% (₹250)।

Dupatta Fabric 250 × 4010,000
Salwar Fabric 250 × 6015,000
Raw Material Cost33,600
Job Work Charges 100 × 505,000
Total Cost38,600
Cost per Pcs = 38,600 ÷ 100386

✅ Check

Raw Material Cost = ₹8,600 + ₹10,000 + ₹15,000 = ₹33,600 ✔

Job Work Charges = ₹5,000 • Total Cost = ₹38,600 • Cost per Pcs = ₹386 ✔

Job Work Charges पर GST ₹250 (CGST ₹125 + SGST ₹125) — ITC है, Product Cost में नहीं जुड़ता ✔
